boundary.crucial_scalar_null: Every q=2,4,...,14 row has an exact feasible first-15-coefficient scalar control with x7=x8=x9=0.

conditional_scope: scalar theta cones attached to the Wave 71 level-7 lattice rows q=2,4,...,14 for a hypothetical srg(99,14,1,2)

dictionary_scope.not_certified: No signed-unit-support or integer-eigenvector dictionary is asserted for x10,x11,x12,x13,x14.

mod2_lattice_upper_comparisons.assessment: These universal rank-44 lattice upper bounds are many orders of magnitude above the verified scalar LP lower bounds.
mod2_lattice_upper_comparisons.proof: If u and v are non-antipodal representatives of one class modulo 2K, then (u+v)/2 and (u-v)/2 are nonzero lattice vectors and the parallelogram law forces ||u||^2+||v||^2 at least 4*min(K)=56. Thus below norm 28 each nonzero class has at most one antipodal pair. At norm 28, equality forces same-class representatives to be pairwise orthogonal, hence at most rank(K)=44 antipodal pairs. The same 44-pair cap bounds both the unweighted and weights-8-through-1 sums per nonzero mod-2 class.

mod7_scope.scope: For q=2,4,...,14 the level-one mod-7 congruence forces no affine relation among x7,x8,x9, and every tested prefix or triangular objective varies in an affine direction. Only antipodal evenness is used to round the rational LP bounds.

normalizations.x: Theta_K, with x_n counting vectors of norm 2n
